primary.version: Original cartridge with same-region Voice Recognition Unit and microphone

primary.how_to_play: Use an original NTSC-J or NTSC-U Nintendo 64 cartridge, a same-region Nintendo 64 console, and the matching VRU/microphone plugged into controller port 4. Use the analog stick for navigation and voice commands for Pikachu; avoid PAL assumptions because the VRU was not released there.

entries.remaster_caveats: No Virtual Console, Switch Online, remake, or remaster release is sourced. Pokémon Channel has similar Pikachu-care themes but is a separate GameCube game, not a rerelease or replacement. The VRU is region-sensitive and NintendoWiki states it was never released in PAL regions.
